items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I can remember during an intermission when I went out to get stoned he looked a little bit like me with glasses and we were teased.

ctx.x: Yeah, and . . . oh lord what the hell is his name? I can remember during an intermission when I went out to get stoned he looked a little bit like me with glasses and we were teased. What the hell is his name?
